    import heapq
    
    # Sort safety islands including the start and end points
    d = sorted(d)
    
    # Priority queue to store (time, position, direction)
    pq = [(0, 0, 1)]
    
    # Set to keep track of visited states (time, position, direction)
    visited = set()
    
    while pq:
        time, pos, direction = heapq.heappop(pq)
        
        # If we reach the end of the road
        if pos == n:
            return time
        
        # If this state has been visited before, skip it
        if (time, pos, direction) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((time, pos, direction))
        
        # Calculate the next green light start time
        cycle_time = g + r
        next_green_start = ((time // cycle_time) * cycle_time) + g
        
        # Move forward or backward based on the current direction
        new_pos = pos + direction
        
        # Check if the new position is within bounds
        if 0 <= new_pos <= n:
            # If the new position is a safety island or the end of the road
            if new_pos in d or new_pos == n:
                # Move to the new position
                heapq.heappush(pq, (time + 1, new_pos, direction))
            
            # Change direction if possible
            if new_pos in d:
                heapq.heappush(pq, (time + 1, new_pos, -direction))
        
        # Wait for the next green light if necessary
        if time < next_green_start:
            heapq.heappush(pq, (next_green_start, pos, direction))
    
    return -1
